_about: Single source for the reading list's allowed values. Each value is paired with the exact wording used on the page and in the Google Form. Change wording here and in the form together. See docs/reading-list-process.md § 3.2.

category.label: Picture books
category.description: Illustrated books, usually read to a child by an adult.

category.label: Easy readers
category.description: Short, simple books for a child learning to read on their own.

category.label: Chapter books
category.description: First books with chapters — short, larger type, for a newly independent reader.

category.label: Middle grade
category.description: Longer books for a confident independent reader.

category.label: New adult
category.description: Books for older teens that include sexual content. Reading difficulty alone does not put a book here — a hard book with none of it belongs in young adult.
category.form: New adult (ages 15+, may include sexual content)

read_aloud_description: Books for an adult to read to a child. Children understand harder words and bigger ideas by listening than they can read on their own, so these books can aim higher.

domain.label: Science
domain.description: Biology, chemistry, earth science, physics and engineering. Biology books may describe reproduction and anatomy in factual terms.

domain.label: History
domain.description: Past peoples and events. These books may show violence, slavery and war.

domain.label: Civics
domain.description: How people govern themselves: laws, rights and citizenship.

domain.label: Geography
domain.description: Places, maps, and how people live around the world.

domain.label: Mythology
domain.description: Myths, legends and fables from around the world.

domain.label: Art and music
domain.description: How art and music are made, and who made them.

form.label: Nonfiction
form.description: Factual books about real people, events and ideas.

form.label: Fiction
form.description: Stories that teach something real, such as a historical event, a scientific idea or a work of art.

form.label: Reference
form.description: Books to look things up in, such as atlases.

use.label: Class set
use.form: Class set (a teacher could buy one for every student)
